why I built it

I built what I couldn't find.

The story behind Vivora — and why it only speaks your language.

I moved to Sweden and studied Swedish for years — classes, apps, endless flashcards — and still froze the second a real conversation started. Every app drilled words and streaks, but none of them let me just talk. And people are too kind: they hear you struggle and switch to English, so you never get the reps. So I built Vivora — a warm voice that only speaks your language, never judges, and hands you the word the moment you freeze. The practice I always wished I had.

Mankirat Singh

Founder

Stockholm, Sweden
